intro.text: So. You dropped out of university. To trade. On a laptop. In your room.
We love you! But we also love our savings account. Here is $20,000. It is all we have, plus a little bit of guilt.
One hundred days. We check in on you at regular intervals. Miss the numbers once, and you are asking for a job. Probably at McTrade's Burger Emporium.
Relax, kid. Read the news, trust your gut, ignore your gut when it is wrong. Reach $1,000,000 and you never have to flip a burger again.

howToPlay.title: Read the world
howToPlay.text: News pops up on the map. Some of it moves prices instantly. Some of it is a warning shot with a follow-up. Some of it is a rumour.

howToPlay.title: Trade anything
howToPlay.text: Stocks, gold, oil, crypto and forex. Go long when you expect a rise, go short when you expect a crash.

howToPlay.title: Pass the checkpoints
howToPlay.text: Your parents review your wealth at set days. Miss the minimum once and it is over. Reach $1M and you win on the spot.

howToPlay.title: Time never waits
howToPlay.text: Reading is not free. The clock runs while you think. Pause when you must. You cannot trade while paused.

10.pass: Day 10! Dad says you are "fine". That is his version of a trophy.

20.pass: Twenty days in. Still has a laptop. I am cautiously not yelling.

40.pass: Day 40 and still alive! I told your parents you would make it. I was lying, but nicely.
40.fail: Well. That is a bad day.

60.pass: Sixty days! We told the neighbours you are "in finance". They asked which kind.

80.pass: Eighty days? Cute. I started trading at 14. In my head. Without money. Very profitable.

95.pass: You are really doing it. Do not mess it up now. No pressure. A little pressure.

win.title: Financial freedom
lines: You hit $1,000,000. Dad stopped talking mid-sentence and sat down.
Mom cried. Chad texted "cool" and then called three times.
The burger emporium sent a handwritten note: "We will wait."

lose.title: Plan B activated
lines: Your parents have arranged an interview. You will start Monday.
Please read the terms carefully, or sign them quickly. Both are traditional.
clauses: I understand that trading is, in fact, not a career.
I will not describe fries as "a position".
I agree to the uniform, the hat and the little name tag.
I accept that the ketchup is not a hedge.

reasons.bankrupt: Your total wealth fell to zero or below. Bankruptcy is immediate.
reasons.checkpoint: You missed a parent review. Checkpoints are checked once, at the end of the named day.
reasons.deadline: Day 100 arrived and you were short of $1,000,000.
